about: Reconstructed scripted story scenes (no fight). The original server drove their stages with an encounter script the client does not ship. Each scene is a sequence of steps; a step names the DungeonQuestConfig quest the tracker shows (var 10001) and its goal counter (var 10003), the scene actors the server shows during it (client NPCConfig ids at scene-editor points, with the buffs that open their interactions), an optional story the client plays (dungeon var 100020016), the client events that complete it, and an optional teleport after it. Every decision carries its reason and the scene its confidence; what is guessed is listed per scene. Switch: Ro3Emu:ReconstructedDungeons. Never mixed into client data.

contract.interaction: 32700 NpcInteractionReq {npc_uid, interaction_id} on a scene actor: the client sends it from LC_DAL_Interact.SendNPCInteractionReq when the player presses the interaction's skill button (InteractMode 3 ClickSkillIcon), walks into range (2 AutoInteractWhenInRange) or a dialogue option runs action 211 TriggerNpcInteract (LC_InteractActions.lua:5672-5698). The interaction must be one of the actor's NPCConfig _iInteractID; the server answers 32700 with the request echoed (LC_InteractManager._onInteractResponse then runs the client-hosted actions, e.g. 53 NPCInteractDialogue).
contract.message: The NPCInteractConfig _iEXECAction ["210", id, ...] of that interaction: ActionConfig 210 SendDungeonMessage is server-hosted (_iEXECHost 1), so the client never runs it; it is the dungeon script's own message id (LC_InteractManager.lua:1975-2030 runs only client/all-hosted actions).
contract.gate: An interaction's _iNPCCondition 1004 CheckHaveBuff (LC_CommonCondition.lua:180-196) asks whether the actor carries a BuffConfig group (_iBuffID). The client shows the button only then, so the step that waits on an interaction gives its actor that buff.
contract.story: Dungeon var 100020016 (DungeonVariableFunctionConfig: start function PlayCutSceneStory, array) with [plot] makes the client play PlotInterpretation <plot> (LC_DunGeon_Actions.lua:3476-3490, LC_CutSceneManager.PlayStory). At its end (also when skipped) the plot's action 601 VideoPerformEndClient sends 84011 PlotActingEnd {plotId} (LC_GuildServer.PlotActionEnd), its action 150 PlotActingTrigger sends 84012 {plotId} (LC_TaskHelper.PlotActingTriggerReq), and 32709 follows; either one completes the step, neither expects a reply. Sent once in a 30404 DungeonEventDungeonVarChange: LC_DunGeon_Base._pushDungeonVars calls the function on every push, so it is never kept in the 30401 snapshot.
contract.region: The scene editor's server regions (regionType 2; no client consumer registers them with LC_TriggerAreaManager, so the client never reports them): the server tests the participant's walked position with LC_AreaHelper.CheckInArea's geometry (shapeType 1 circle radius = length, 2 rectangle length x width turned by direction).
contract.point: No region exists; the participant's walked position within radius metres of the scene-editor point (inferred).

Editor sc_plot_yhcx_002_dg01 labels: point 23 'Bobo position', 29 'soldier ant (Deniro) position', 27 'fluorescent substance position'; guide points 26 'rescue Bobo', 33 'interact with the ant', 34 'collect the fluorescent substance', 35 'ride the soldier ant', 36 'riding' (down the ramp to region 31 'end region').

Bobo 5300041 has interaction 5300028 (skill 5362101 'Rescue Bobo', message 5300028, NPC condition buff 53014). Deniro 5300005 has 5300005 (skill 'Ride', vehicle status 3, message 5300005, buff 53654), 5300009 (skill 'Feed', message 5300009, buff 53653) and 5300008 (skill 'Ride', message 5300008, buff 53651). NPC 5300055 (collect-light model 100144) has 5300010 (skill 'Collect', message 5300010, buff 53652).
Each interaction is gated by its own buff (BuffConfig 5301401, 5365401, 5365201, 5365301, 5365101), so exactly one of them is open at a time: the step order is the quest order.
guessed: Bobo stays where he was helped up for the rest of the scene; patrol 28 (his short walk) is not animated.

Collecting the fluorescent substance grants no item: no item is named by the client data.
The ride to the depths (guide 36 down the ramp through regions 38, 37 and 31, camera prefab mianstorybingyicamera) is a teleport to region 31's centre.

3120402.name: Culvert: Louie's game
evidence: DungeonQuestConfig 5300036 (quest 1 'Complete Louie's game', goal 'Find Kitty-Katie' [5,0,1]) and 5300037 (quest 2 'Retrieve Instrument', goal type 1 without a counter).

PlotInterpretation 140010 and 140020 are run-time stories 1013 and 1014 that no task triggers. Story 1013 (StoryData_1013) shows Louie, Martha, Katie and Fervor in this Culvert, plays dialogues 1010627001-1010627003 ('Let's play a game ... The three of us will hide inside these three Bells, and you'll have to guess where each of us is') and walks Martha, Louie and Katie to x 40, 50 and 60. Story 1014 reveals them at (40, 55), (50, 55), (60, 55), Katie at x 60, and plays 1010627004 (they leave with the bow tie).

NPCs 400134-400136 (bell ring effect 20002): their auto dialogues 20003001-20005001 say 'Here's Katie the kitty!' with 'Choose this one!' running action 211 TriggerNpcInteract on interaction 5300040, 5300041 or 5300042; these send dungeon messages 11 (400134) and 12 (400135, 400136).
